_about: Curated, vetted third-party skills. Install ONLY on first need, after the teacher says yes (see skill-scout.md). Licenses were read from the repos on 2026-11-19; re-check before use. Entries with license NONE are guide-only. Every entry was checked with `skill_scout.py verify` (exists, license, last push, no curl|sh text) on 2026-11-19 unless status says unverified; monorepo entries need the folder's own LICENSE read before use.

skills.name: pptx
skills.for: Create/edit real .pptx files (our teacher-slides makes web decks, not .pptx)
skills.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill pptx -a claude-code

skills.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill docx -a claude-code

skills.name: modern-web-guidance
skills.for: Current web-platform guidance when building/fixing web pages or sites
skills.install: npx skills add GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance -a claude-code (skill name not checked; read its SKILL.md first)

skills.name: security-audit-skill
skills.for: One-time security review before publishing a site/tool (uses many sub-agents; tell the teacher it is slow)

skills.name: kordoc
skills.for: Read HWP/HWPX, extract forms, Markdown to HWPX (3k stars, active). Candidate only: SKILL.md and scripts not yet read; vet before use. Another option on this machine may already exist (hwp-docs plugin).
skills.install: npx skills add chrisryugj/kordoc -a claude-code (skill name not verified)

skills.name: doc-coauthoring
skills.license: UNVERIFIED (repo root has no LICENSE, folder has only SKILL.md): guide-only until checked
skills.for: Structured co-writing of proposals and plans. Already installed on some machines as anthropic-skills:doc-coauthoring: use that one.
skills.install: (use the installed one; do not install this)

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.for: 10 ready themes for docs/decks; our shared/design is first choice, this is a second opinion.
skills.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill theme-factory -a claude-code

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.for: Idea to plan dialogue (explore context, options with a recommendation, approval). For developers' work; for teachers use our co-plan.
skills.install: npx skills add obra/superpowers --skill brainstorming -a claude-code

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.for: Turns an approved idea into ordered steps.
skills.install: npx skills add obra/superpowers --skill writing-plans -a claude-code

skills.name: grilling
skills.for: Asks decision questions in one batch with a recommended answer each (our ask-first rule is built on this idea).

skills.name: frontend-slides

skills.name: find-skills

skills.name: marketingskills (content-strategy, copywriting, social, marketing-plan, video, customer-research)

skills.install: npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills --skill content-strategy -a claude-code (folder names verified; pick one at a time)

skills.name: knowledge-work-plugins (data, marketing, productivity, design)
skills.for: Official plugin set; several are already installed as plugins on some machines (data:analyze, marketing:campaign-plan). Check your own skill list first.
skills.install: Claude Code: /plugin (read the details pane first)
skills.note: For spreadsheets from teachers use teacher-data (never reads raw rows); these plugins read data.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.license: not checked (built into Claude apps; no repo found)
skills.for: Multi-source research report. Use when it is in your skill list; otherwise web search + our co-plan.
